title: Spire and Veil
author: Paloma Thornbury
blurb: Noor Ravensworth, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
